basic_details.job_title: IIMB Academic Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is hiring an Academic Associate for its Public Policy Area. The appointment is initially for one year and can be extended up to a maximum of three years, with an all-inclusive monthly stipend of ₹43,000/- to ₹55,000/- based on experience. Candidates need a Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Public Health, Population Studies, Hospital Administration, International Relations or other related disciplines. Applications are made online through the institute's application link, and the closing date is 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates may fill out the application online using the link given in the notice (listed under Important Links below) on or before 10 November 2026. All fields in the application form are mandatory. The following documents must be uploaded when submitting the application.
Diploma/Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final diploma/degree certificate
Masters/Post-Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final degree certificate
An application submitted without these documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About IIMB Academic Associate - Public Policy Area
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) describes itself as a leading graduate school of management in Asia. Under the IIM Act of 2017, IIMB is an Institute of National Importance. The notice lists its industry or service as Higher Education. The Academic Associate post is in its Public Policy Area and reports to the Chairperson - Public Policy Area.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Candidates are required to hold a Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Public Health, Population Studies, Hospital Administration, International Relations or other related disciplines. Profile sought: According to the notice, the position suits candidates with excellent academic credentials who have a long-term interest in doing their doctoral program and in teaching and research. content_sections.heading: IIMB Academic Associate - Public Policy Area Job Description
content_sections.text: The Academic Associate reports to the Chairperson - Public Policy Area. The principal accountabilities and responsibilities printed in the notice are: The candidate is required to provide research and teaching support to the faculty depending on the requirements of the faculty. The candidate should be willing and interested to assist faculty on all aspects of their academic research and teaching work. The candidate should support the proctoring duties of the institute as and when assigned and other assignments that are given from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMB Academic Associate - Public Policy Area
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may fill out the application online using the link given in the notice (listed under Important Links below) on or before 10 November 2026. All fields in the application form are mandatory. The following documents must be uploaded when submitting the application. 10th and 12th marksheets Diploma/Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final diploma/degree certificate Masters/Post-Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final degree certificate An application submitted without these documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIMB Recruitment 2026 for Academic Associate - Public Policy Area?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Academic Associate - Public Policy Area. The notice does not print a number, so the post is counted as one vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIMB Academic Associate post?
faq.answer: The closing date for applications is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIMB Academic Associate - Public Policy Area post?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to hold a Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Public Health, Population Studies, Hospital Administration, International Relations or other related disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for the IIMB Academic Associate - Public Policy Area post?
faq.answer: The all-inclusive monthly stipend is in the range of ₹43,000/- to ₹55,000/-, depending on the applicant's experience.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIMB Academic Associate post?
faq.answer: Fill out the online application through the link given in the notice by 10 November 2026. All fields are mandatory, and the required marksheets and certificates must be uploaded with the application.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be uploaded with the IIMB Academic Associate application?
faq.answer: You must upload your 10th and 12th marksheets, all semester-wise marksheets and the final certificate for your Diploma/Graduation, and all semester-wise marksheets and the final degree certificate for your Masters/Post-Graduation. Applications without these documents will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIMB Academic Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is initially for one year and is extendable up to a maximum period of three years.

faq.question: Q8. What does an Academic Associate in the IIMB Public Policy Area do?
faq.answer: The Academic Associate provides research and teaching support to the faculty, assists faculty with all aspects of their academic research and teaching work, and supports the institute's proctoring duties and other assignments. The post reports to the Chairperson - Public Policy Area.

faq.question: Q9. Will every applicant hear back from IIMB?
faq.answer: No. According to the notice, only shortlisted candidates will be intimated.
